shared_elements: schematic linear carvings on a rock surface
possible human or animal figures rendered schematically
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic, non-naturalistic carved marks on rock, but A shows a legible repertoire of crescent-hulled boats with rows of vertical crew-strokes, staff-bearing human figures and lines of cup-like dots arranged in loose registers, none of which is identifiable in B. B's carvings are broad curvilinear, swirling relief forms with no recognisable boats, figures or dot rows, so beyond the generic fact of incised abstract marks there is no shared motif or relationship.
